---
title: "simPCL: An open-framework simulator and benchmark generator for programmable cloud laboratories"
authors: "Barazandeh, S., Kaynar, G., Banka, A., Kangas, J., Kingsford, C., Lugo-Martinez, J."
venue: "Manuscript in preparation"
year: 2026
---

simPCL is a simulator and benchmark generator for programmable cloud laboratories. The laboratory setting is the application domain; the research questions are simulation, agent evaluation, and benchmarking for autonomous laboratory systems and agentic scientific discovery.
